items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: Yeah. Anyway about him going to Napoleon and Ferret at 3 a.m. With Herb, Albert Burbank, Albert Giles, Prince Gabriel and three white companions.

ctx.x: somebody let probably Greenwood know and they checked and they said whether we could come or not and they said sure come on. So we did. Well I think I brought along my college roommate Johnny Seicher who liked jazz. Is he showing any of the photos? Yeah he's in one of the Smoking a Seagull? Oh no. He's not one of us. He was obviously listening to the band. Yeah he was the first one. Johnny was the one who told me about the New Orleans Record Show. First place I heard about it. First person I heard about it from.…

Let's see. His notes if I'm reading them right I'll have to go back and check the journal on this. Greenwood? Yeah. He talks about Chapatulis and Napoleon. Herb Moran was at Campbell's. He's not there anymore and the date I believe is the 10th of December 1949. That's his entry. Yeah that's his entry. He's not there anymore. And uh I read this to you yesterday or a few days ago. Yeah. Anyway about him going to Napoleon and Ferret at 3 a.m. With Herb, Albert Burbank, Albert Giles, Prince Gabriel and three white…

I know. It could have been Bob Matthews, you and somebody else. Could well have been. Eight people in the car. Could well have been. We didn't, none of us had wheels at that time. I didn't even know how to drive at that time. Uh I certainly it was in the latter part of November. Uh huh. That Matthews and I'm pretty sure Greenwood and I and perhaps somebody else did go to Campbell's and took some photographs. Could have been on the same night you went to Bergen. I don't know why but I have the impression it was…
